description: This Kotlin source file defines a ViewModel class 'ProductListViewModel' for managing product listing data, search, filtering, and pagination state in an Android application. It uses Android Jetpack components such as ViewModel, LiveData, and Paging, along with Kotlin Coroutines Flow for reactive data handling.

classes.name: ProductListViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing product list, search, filter, and pagination state.

classes.name: ProductListViewModel.QueryParams
classes.description: Data class encapsulating search query and filter parameters.

classes.name: ProductListViewModel.EffectiveParams
classes.description: Data class combining query parameters with the selected category state.

methods.name: refreshCategories
methods.description: Fetches categories from the backend asynchronously and updates the categories list.

methods.name: setSearchQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query value, which triggers updates in the product paging list.

methods.name: selectCategory
methods.description: Selects a category, updating category filter and mode.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Clears all active filters while preserving category selection.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Replaces the entire filter object with a new filter.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears search query, filters, and category selection.

methods.name: applyPreset
methods.description: Applies a saved search query and filter preset.

methods.name: loadCategoryPreview
methods.description: Lazy-loads a preview list of products for a specific category.
